laws.description: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act

rights: Right to reside in the shared household (Sec 17 DV Act)
Right to free legal aid via NALSA (15100)
procedures: Step 1: Emergency - Dial 1091 (Women Helpline) or 112 for immediate police dispatch.
Step 2: Filing - Visit the nearest Protection Officer or 'Mahila Thana' (Women Police Station). You can also file an Online FIR on your state's Citizen Portal.
Step 3: Protection - Request an 'Interim Protection Order' under Section 23 of the DV Act to ensure your immediate safety.
Step 4: Evidence - Save photos of injuries, medical bills, and record abusive calls/messages.

laws.description: Cheating by personation using computer resource

rights: Right to block/report unauthorized transactions immediately
Right to file a complaint at www.cybercrime.gov.in anonymously
Right to have sexually explicit content removed within 24 hours (IT Rules)
procedures: Step 1: Financial Fraud - Call 1930 (National Cybercrime Helpline) within the 'Golden Hour' to freeze the criminal's bank account.
Step 2: Official Portal - File a formal complaint at https://www.cybercrime.gov.in. Keep the 'Acknowledgment Number' for tracking.
Step 3: Evidence - Do NOT delete chats. Export WhatsApp chats as .txt, save URL links of profiles, and take screenshots of transaction IDs.
Step 4: Bank Contact - Inform your bank's Nodal Officer or visit the branch to file a 'Chargeback' request.

rights: Right to an Internal Committee (IC) in any organization with 10+ employees
Right to 'SHe-Box' reporting for Central/State employees
Right to leave/transfer during inquiry to avoid retaliation
procedures: Step 1: Internal Filing - Submit a written complaint to your company's Internal Committee (IC). If they ignore it, you can approach the Local Committee (LC) at the District Collector's office.
Step 2: SHe-Box - File an online complaint on the Ministry of WCD portal: https://shebox.nic.in/
Step 3: Police Case - Simultaneously file an FIR under BNS Section 75 at the nearest police station.
Step 4: Support - Contact the National Commission for Women (NCW) at 011-26237700 for legal assistance.

general_rights: Right to free legal aid under Article 39A
Right to be informed of the grounds of arrest
Right to consult a legal practitioner of choice
Right to be produced before a magistrate within 24 hours
